# CopyPixel <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Buffers and Pixels](BlitzBasic-Buffers-and-Pixels)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CopyPixel:Void src_x:Int32, src_y:Int32, src_buffer:Int32, dest_x:Int32, dest_y:Int32, dest_buffer:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `src_x` | In | Int32 | required | Horizontal position of the pixel to copy. |
| `src_y` | In | Int32 | required | Vertical position of the pixel to copy. |
| `src_buffer` | In | Int32 | required | The buffer to copy from. |
| `dest_x` | In | Int32 | required | Horizontal position to copy to. |
| `dest_y` | In | Int32 | required | Vertical position to copy to. |
| `dest_buffer` | In | Int32 | `0` | The buffer to copy to. Defaults to the current buffer. |

## Description

Copies one pixel from a buffer to another, or inside the same buffer. Each call has to work out where both pixels are, so for many pixels lock the buffers and use [CopyPixelFast](CopyPixelFast).

## Differences

* A source pixel outside of its buffer is read as 0 (black), and a destination outside its buffer is skipped.
* Pixels are copied with all the bits that the buffers have: a buffer made by [Graphics3D](Graphics3D) with the depth 64 does not lose anything on the way. See [Color depth](Graphics#color-depth).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
Color 255, 0, 0
Rect 0, 0, 20, 20, 1
For i = 0 To 19
	CopyPixel i, i, BackBuffer(), 100 + i, 50, BackBuffer()
Next
Flip
WaitKey
```
